studies.title: BT474 cell-line-derived spheroid
studies.citation: D'Imprima E, Mahamid J. Light and electron microscopy continuum-resolution imaging of 3D cell cultures. BioImage Archive S-BIAD610 (2023); https://doi.org/10.1101/2021.07.02.450855.
studies.instrument: Zeiss LSM 780 NLO (study record); not Thermo Fisher
studies.calibrationSource: BT474.tif ImageJ unit=micron, spacing=2.8598338341383296; X/YResolution=3011083/1000000 pixels per micron.
studies.channelCaution: The selected TIFF has no per-channel stain labels. LUTs are not stain identities. Channel 1 has high background and is initially hidden for volume clarity; it remains available. We do not infer marker names.
studies.temporalCaution: One published stack, not a time series. No drug-response metadata is asserted.
studies.transform: Full field; 4x4 XY block mean to 256x256; Z preserved; uint8 intensities retained; TCZYX OME-TIFF and NGFF 0.4 derivatives.

studies.title: Cell Painting / one multichannel field
studies.citation: Chandrasekaran et al. (2024), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02241-6; Weisbart et al. (2024), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02399-z. Cell Painting Gallery cpg0000-jump-pilot, source_4, plate BR00116991, r01c01f01p01. We thank the AWS Open Data Sponsorship Program for sponsoring data storage.
studies.calibrationSource: Index.idx.xml ImageResolutionX/Y=5.979760809567617E-07 m. Z=1 is a singleton indexing placeholder; no axial calibration or depth claim.
studies.channelCaution: Channel labels from primary image metadata. Three of five fluorescence channels selected; brightfield omitted.
studies.temporalCaution: Independent fixed endpoint field; no compound assignment, pairing with BT474, or time trajectory inferred.
studies.transform: 2x2 XY block mean to 540x540; channel order 5,1,2; fixed per-source-channel 1st/99.8th-percentile uint16-to-uint8 mapping, saved in derivative provenance. Display-only, not comparable to synthetic ADU.
